newsitem.title: CHINA: China newspaper says no deaths in Beijing bombing.
newsitem.headline: China newspaper says no deaths in Beijing bombing.

text.p: A bomb that exploded on a Beijing bus on Friday caused no deaths but wounded more than 10 people, the official Beijing Daily said on Saturday.
Chinese sources had said at least two people were killed by the bomb, which went off on a city bus in the capital's western Xidan district early on Friday evening.
"Yesterday evening at about 7.00 pm (1100 GMT), an explosion occurred on a city Number 22 bus at the Xidan Market stop," the Beijing Daily said in a brief front-page report.
"More than 10 passengers were hurt, none was killed," the newspaper said, adding that the incident was under investigation.
Workers at an emergency centre near the bustling commercial area told Reuters they had sent about 30 people injured in the blast to nearby hospitals for treatment.

One man who said he saw the explosion blow the windows out of the back of the bus reported seeing about nine people seriously hurt. A police official said that some people were suffering from burns but he declined to give further details.
